dedupe_keys.name: wind load and performance of elevated structures

description: Wind Load and Performance of Elevated Structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Arindam Gan Chowdhury, Florida International University (fiu.edu). Participated in a research project that investigated the wind load on elevated structures. The investigation with numerical analysis and testing of a model at the Wall of Wind facility. Previous testing and numerical analysis of the elevated house showed that pressure was higher than conventional houses. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-5zmz-ma80. Keywords: Wall of Wind, Florida International University, Elevated Structure, Elevated House, Wind Load. Published 2021-10-05. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
